source_statement: Let triangle ABC be such that AB = AC = 22 and BC = 11. Point D is chosen in the interior of the triangle such that AD = 19 and ∠ABD + ∠ACD = 90◦ . The value of BD2 + CD2 can be expressed as ab , where a and b are relatively prime positive integers. Compute 100a + b.
